adjudications_at_abstract_depth.verdict: MECHANICAL NEAR-MISS, does not answer the gate YES
adjudications_at_abstract_depth.clause_a_certificate: FAILS. The abstract states a purely analytical existence proof; it mentions no computer-assisted proof, no interval arithmetic, no validated numerics, no rigorous computer certificate.
adjudications_at_abstract_depth.clause_b_blow_up: PARTIAL. The breakdown is a SPLASH -- the free-boundary interface self-intersects in finite time -- not a blow-up of a norm of the velocity field, which is the object the Clay statement concerns.
adjudications_at_abstract_depth.why_it_matters_anyway: It is the single strongest thing the four-group author census turned up that this repository had never cited, and it is recorded here with a link so a later leg can re-check the judgement rather than re-run the search.
